title: harsheetamorey/mediaindex
summary: Chat with your photos, search and edit them, 100% on your Mac. Built on EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4.

title: townlight/townlight
summary: Umbrella repo for the open-source CivicSuite municipal operations suite — charter, specs, roadmap, ADRs, governance, compatibility matrix. Code lives in sibling repos.

title: kaiserg/odyssey-7
summary: A hands-on AI engineering lab exploring RAG, document intelligence, and LoRA fine-tuning with local LLMs, Python, and a sci-fi spaceship interface.

title: T-Crypt/berth
summary: Decides who gets your GPU. Chat, image and voice engines lease the card in turn instead of grabbing it, so two of them never load at once and crash each other. One Go binary, nothing else to install.

title: sangingeum/code-indexer
summary: Semantic code search for agents: one-shot CLI + MCP server over Qdrant + Ollama (Linux)

title: coddy-project/coddy-agent
summary: General-purpose agent in one static Go binary: console TUI, ACP server for editors, OpenAI-compatible API with embedded web UI, Telegram gateway, cron scheduler, swarm relay, remote mode. Rules, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, background tasks, long-term memory, context compaction. Any OpenAI-compatible provider, distroless-ready.

title: roy032/bd-legal-rag
summary: Bilingual (Bangla + English) RAG over Bangladeshi law with section-level citations and refusal when the corpus has no answer. Hybrid retrieval, evaluated on 86 questions.

title: Merp4/dexicon
summary: Semantic search over your own code, documents and git history, for coding agents over MCP. One container on your machine: local embeddings with Ollama, hybrid search with Qdrant, and a web UI.

title: CorvinLabs/CorvinOS
summary: Self-hosted agentic OS — a Vibe-Engineering platform for Builders. Connect Claude Code Agent to Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack & Email. EU AI Act 2026 & GDPR compliance by architecture.

title: ScottMichel/tradforge
summary: Translate your project's texts with a local LLM (Ollama), with strict validation, a translation memory and incremental resume

title: steventsvik/Tellurion
summary: Mission control for AI coding agents. Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and a dozen more work live in one macOS terminal: live status, an editor that follows their edits, undo for any turn, approvals from your phone and local models. 20+ built-in tools, all on the site below. Built on Ghostty.

title: scs0209/dropzone-zero
summary: A local agent that keeps your Downloads folder tidy, with every move reversible.

title: yanacuti1121/Yana-AI
summary: Yana AI 🐰  One runtime. Any AI. Human-governed.  A local-first, cross-platform system for running, connecting, orchestrating, and governing AI — with deterministic control over what it can access, change, and execute.  Your AI can act. But who decides how far it can go?

title: Parad0x-Labs/vool
summary: VOOL — the local-first personal agent runtime by Parad0x Labs: local LLM by default, memory, tools, permissions and signed receipts. macOS beta.

title: EM917/tiktok-live-translator
summary: Local real-time speech-to-subtitle translation for TikTok LIVE: Whisper + RNNoise + Hy-MT2, fully on-device, no API key / 本地实时 TikTok 直播同传字幕

title: Pigeon-Home/homing-pigeon
summary: Homing Pigeon is a self-hosted cloud-SI-controlled local agent and protocol. Tell your cloud SI (Grok, ChatGPT, etc.) to send signed jobs via email which then execute on your machine: Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Windows or any container. An oracle on the host watches to ensure nothing bad or unintended occurs. Modern LLMs, meet: netcat.

title: kagura-ai/memory-cloud
summary: Adaptive memory for AI agents & teams — beyond RAG. Self-hosted MCP server that gets smarter every time you search: hybrid search + a neural memory graph that learns. Works with Claude, ChatGPT & any MCP client.

title: phinn/KinetAios
summary: Local-first multi-engine AI agent dashboard — Claude Code, Codex & built-in ReAct in one window. MCP support, skills auto-loading, long-term memory. No account, no relay.

title: Wulfgardr/mediflow
summary: Gestionale gratuito e a codice aperto per cartelle cliniche, documenti e attività ambulatoriali. Utilizzabile anche senza intelligenza artificiale.

title: noisyloop/Fleet-51
summary: Your own fleet of alien AI bots, running privately on your computer. Name a bot, give it a face, pick a free local model (Ollama), and chat. Run many at once, schedule automations, work offline. Sandboxed, undoable, no cloud, no account. Free and open source.
